rule: Generation is a declared step graph: each provider Produces, Requires or Updates named facets, the builder assembles per-facet chains from those declarations, errors on a missing producer, detects cycles by update priority, and grows per-facet chunk borders from requirements. Zones are region predicates that overlay a chunk and restore blocks outside their region. Layered zones stack thickness ranges per column from the surface. The world seed is one 32-bit value copied to every provider and zone, so layers that share a rule share a noise pattern.

data_fields.name: updatePriority
data_fields.donor_value_or_null: 250 produces, 200 critical, 150 high, 100 normal, 50 low, 0 trivial, -50 requires

keep: declared produces, requires and updates graph checked at build time
named error when a required producer is missing
zone overlay that rasterizes only inside its region and restores everything outside
skip a zone that has no block in the chunk
change: one world seed shared by every layer: derive a per-zone seed from world seed plus zone id
32-bit string hash for the world seed: use a 64-bit hash of the zone id
rasterizer with a missing facet is dropped silently: make it a build error that names the rasterizer
zone initialize called twice (donor TODO): run once or make idempotent
look_test: Render one column of two stacked bands from one seed, once with the shared seed and once with a per-zone seed, same thickness rule. Dom says on his phone whether the shared-seed pair looks like a copy. If yes, build the per-zone seed.
